ahrc.definition: The conclusion of a determinate period of time. Also, again; a repetition of time, either definite or indefinite; another time; once more. Alternate Translations: again; also; as far as; as well as; before; beyond; by; concerning; even; for; unto; still (when followed by the word " IN.THIS.WAY ")

Interrogative expressing inquiry about the identity, nature, or value of an object. Can also be why, when or how. Alternate Translations: how; why; how many (when prefixed with " like~ "); what is the reason (when prefixed with " to~ " and followed by the word " THIS ") Alternate Spellings: מה
To put out of sight; to conceal from view; to keep secret. Hide or conceal. Alternate Spellings: שתר Edenics: mystery
